paragraphs: On Thursday, the Explorers sat in a circle in the library. Teacher Kim had a game called the Hobby Circle. "Each child has a turn," she said. "Tell us about your hobby, and say why you like it." Everyone was ready, and Leo had a small clock in his hand. "One minute for each child," he said. "Hurry, Mia, you are first!"

"I usually take photos after school," said Mia. "I like animals, and Snow is my best model." "Snow is a white kitten, and she never sits still." "Last week, I took twenty photos of her in one hour." "Why do you like photos?" asked May. "A photo keeps a happy day," said Mia. "Then I can look at it again."

"Now it is my turn," said May. "My hobby is music, and I play the flute." "A flute is a thin instrument, and you play it with your mouth." "My grandma gave it to me." "The sound makes me quiet and happy, and I play it every evening." "Has anyone ever played an instrument?" asked Teacher Kim. "I played the drum once," said Leo. "It was very loud!"

"Leo, it is your turn," said Mia. "My hobby is cards," said Leo. "I play with my grandma every Sunday." "She is a very good player, and she is usually the winner." "I do not mind, because she laughs a lot." "Do you like cartoons too?" asked May. "Yes, but cartoons are my job for the blog," said Leo. "Cards are only for fun."

"Lily, it is your turn," said Teacher Kim. "I like to write," said Lily. "I write on the blog, and I chat with Grace in Singapore every month." "That makes me happy, because I can tell a story." "Your hobbies are all different," said Teacher Kim. "Now it is my turn." "I like to walk in the old town on Sunday."
text.summary: In the club hour, Teacher Kim plays the Hobby Circle with the Explorers. Each child takes a turn to tell about a hobby and why they like it, and then Teacher Kim tells about her own hobby.
